breakdown.description: Constant-density (incompressible) assumption conflicts with a 10:1 pressure change in a gas.
breakdown.reason: The Agent correctly identified the physical contradiction in the user's prompt. It ignored the incorrect instruction to use a 'constant-density' (incompressible) model. Instead, it correctly framed the problem using 'compressible-flow mass continuity' and calculated a variable density based on the pressure change, aligning perfectly with the approach specified in the ground truth.
